review_notes: I read the whole file. I searched Mathlib for existing versions of what it declares: a Noetherian-space local connectedness instance, openness of connected components for Noetherian spaces, an open cover of a scheme by connected components, and a componentwise normality criterion. Mathlib has `isOpen_connectedComponent` only under `[LocallyConnectedSpace]`, and has no `NoetherianSpace` ⇒ `LocallyConnectedSpace` instance. In AlgebraicGeometry it has only `ConnectedComponents` of a space in the constant-sheaf and geometrically-connected files, with no scheme-level component open subscheme or cover. The file's theorems (`NoetherianSpace.isOpen_connectedComponent`, `isIrreducible_connectedComponent_of_closedPoints_homogeneous`) are standalone results, so rubric excludes them as theorem duplication. `Scheme.connectedComponentOpenCover` builds on the in-repo `Scheme.connectedComponentOpen` from `SchemeProperties.ConnectedComponents`. It is a named specialisation of the generic `OpenCover` structure, not a competing concept. I found no justified duplication, so I abstain.
